name: M3_MMS200MI_UpdItmWhs
description: Update warehouse-specific item settings for an existing item and warehouse combination. This operation edits parameters that control the basic behavior of the interface item in a specific warehouse, such as on‑hand and reserved balances, allocation and storage methods, issue methods, safety stock and reorder point values, lead times, annual demand settings, ABC classifications, consignment and catch‑weight controls, and outbound tracking options. It is typically used when an external system or an administrator needs to align M3’s warehouse item configuration with current business rules. The operation does not return data; it only applies the requested changes to the selected item/warehouse record.
